parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The uuidV4 identifier of the app version.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Returns the events recorded strictly before this timestamp. Echo back the `next_before` of the previous response verbatim, keeping its microseconds.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of events returned per request.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Returns only the events whose title contains this text, case-insensitively.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the inclusive time range to return events from. Must be given together with `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the inclusive time range to return events from. Must be given together with `from`.

parameters.name: triggered_by[]
parameters.description: Returns only the events triggered by any of these actors. A value is either a user slug, or a machine actor's `type` (`store`, `automation`, `preset`) rather than its `label`: the type matches every string of its kind, where a label matches only itself.
